entities.summary: Communication design is a mixed discipline between design and information-development concerned with how media communicates with people. A communication design approach is concerned with developing the message and aesthetics in media. It also creates new media channels to ensure the message reaches the target audience. Due to overlapping skills, some designers use graphic design and communication design interchangeably.
